name: Mikuriya Haruna
source:
An S-Class Nuisance (to the protagonist only)

Occupation: College student
Height: Short
Breast Size: Big

Haruna was the protagonist's junior during middle school. Due to the protagonist's family circumstances, their interaction lasted only one term, but she left a lasting impression — mostly because she was pretty annoying.

She used to be overly clingy, but our protagonist just couldn't take her seriously. Haruna was too much like a guy back then, and he didn't really see her as girlfriend material. 

However, things have changed. When the protagonist ran into Haruna again after all this time, she had pretty blossomed. She'd gone from a flat-chested tomboy to a total feminine figure with curves in all the right places.

[Translated/edited from official website]
